name: divix
description: Divix: sistema de control cambiario. Backend (NestJS) y frontend (React) en un solo repositorio.

scripts.instalar: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors green,blue --kill-others-on-fail "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix backend run test:e2e
